backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing products, orders, user profiles, and service quote requests with admin-gated retrieval and update functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing files, components, and tests supporting a clean rebuild and redeploy of the storefront.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend source file.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment checklist covering public access, admin auth, routing behavior, share features, and build verification.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH-driven light and dark theme color variables and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point including metadata, favicon, and script bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/public/404.html: SPA fallback page that captures deep-link paths and redirects to root while preserving navigation intent.
Shell script that removes caches, reinstalls dependencies, type-checks, builds, and validates frontend build output.
frontend/scripts/smoke-public-admin-rout: Manual smoke-test checklist ensuring all public routes work and admin routes enforce authentication and role checks.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup defining public, product, checkout, request-quote, and admin routes wrapped with global providers.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary that catches UI errors and displays a fallback UI with reset and refresh options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with contact info, navigation links, social icons, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with site branding, navigation links, share button, and cart indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Page layout wrapper rendering header, footer, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product image, info, price, and link to product details.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: Button that copies the current page URL to the clipboard with fallback logic and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/FaqSe: FAQ section rendering accordion items for common questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Testi: Testimonials grid showing customer reviews with names, locations, and ratings.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Trust: Section listing trust badges with icons and short descriptions.
frontend/src/constants/serviceAreaCopy.t: Exports constant describing service area text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor using identity, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLeads.ts: Hooks for fetching and updating service quotes via the backend actor with react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Hooks for retrieving all orders and updating order status using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating product data through an actor, including create, update, archive, and restore operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminUsers.ts: Adds a hook to grant admin permissions by email, with query invalidation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Defines a hook to retrieve the current user's role via the actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider for managing authentication state, identity loading, login, and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Exposes a mutation hook to place orders through the actor and invalidate order queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Contains hooks to fetch active products and individual product details using React Query and the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceQuotes.ts: Provides a mutation hook to request service quotes with query invalidation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode styles, and global base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Admin layout handling authentication, role validation, and navigation for admin sections.
Displays and manages service quote leads with status updates and admin notes via dialogs and tables.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Lists all orders and allows admins to update order statuses using a table interface.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Provides product CRUD operations, including creation, editing, and archiving through dialogs and tables.
Allows granting admin permissions to users by email and displays usage guidance.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Renders the shopping cart UI with item quantity management, removal, and navigation to product browsing or checkout.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Implements the checkout form, validates user input, constructs order data, submits orders, and navigates to confirmation on success.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero banner, trust signals, service highlights, and navigation buttons to quotes and products.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays order confirmation details with order ID and a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed product info with image, price, description, quantity selector, and add‑to‑cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/RequestQuotePage.tsx: Form page for requesting service quotes with validation and success confirmation handling.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Storefront hero section with trust signals, service highlights, and a list of active products with navigation helpers.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Implements a persistent Zustand store for cart items with add, remove, update, and total calculation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a clean rebuild task, existing features, and project configuration details.
